sources.title: Countries of the world: entry regime for citizens of Ukraine
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Ukraine
sources.officialityEvidence: This is the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Ukraine's mfa.gov.ua travel-entry URL. Normal certificate verification succeeded, but its Cloudflare response was HTTP 403, so it is retained only as a transport audit and supplies no country result.

sources.title: MFA TripAdvisor interactive travel map
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Ukraine
sources.officialityEvidence: This Ministry of Foreign Affairs subdomain is the referenced interactive travel-map host. Normal certificate verification succeeded, but its Cloudflare response was HTTP 403, preventing any selected-country result; it supplies no relationship evidence.

unresolved.reason: Ukraine MFA identifies its interactive entry-regime map as the traveller resource, but direct normal-TLS replay of the map and current entry-regime page returned HTTP 403; cached/search renderings are not used. No separately replayable Ukrainian or destination primary source directly maps this ordinary Ukrainian passport to one short-visitor route with actual issuance timing. Historic, conditional, third-country-document and operational-war material cannot establish the baseline; no complement is inferred.
